title: genista tinctoria subsp. delarbrei
intro: Genista tinctoria subsp. delarbrei, commonly known as Dyers Greenweed, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family and is native to Europe and Western Asia. Dyers Greenweed has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dyers Greenweed include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
